newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy mkt sees room for further rate cuts.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy mkt sees room for further rate cuts.

text.p: Italian implicit overnight rates are above the 7.5 percent official discount rate on a one-month horizon but fall under this level on a three-month timeframe, a study by Bocconi University's research arm Igier showed.
The Bank of Italy on Wednesday cut the discount rate by 75 basis points to 7.5 percent and the ordinary advances, or Lombard rate, by the same amount to 9.0 percent.

Igier saw the implicit overnight rate on a one-month horizon at 7.71 percent from 8.22 percent seen a week ago and an official market close of 7.88 percent on Thursday, the day on which it based its study.
The implicit overnight rate was seen at 8.18 percent one month ago.
On a three-month timeframe, Igier saw implicit overnight rates at 7.45 percent from 7.88 percent seen a week ago and 7.97 percent seen a month ago.

On a one-year horizon, it saw the implicit overnight rate falling to 6.99 percent from 7.19 percent seen a week ago. In two years' time, it forecast an implicit overnight rate of 7.29 percent from 7.41 percent forecast a week ago.

The spread betweeen the Italian implicit overnight rate and the German implicit overnight rate on a two-year horizon, considered a good indicator of market confidence in Europe's Economic and Monetary Union, is seen falling to 237 basis points from 257 basis points seen a week ago and 293 basis points forecast one month ago.
